_about: Companies building new reactor technology. Edit freely. stage: concept | design | licensing | construction | critical (test reactor reached criticality) | operating | experiment (fusion device running). Headline milestones checked Nov 2026; verify details before relying on them.

companies.name: TerraPower
companies.tech: Sodium-cooled fast reactor with molten-salt heat storage
companies.milestone: First NRC construction permit for a commercial non-light-water reactor (Mar 2026); building Kemmerer Unit 1, Wyoming.

companies.name: GE Vernova Hitachi
companies.tech: Boiling water SMR with passive safety
companies.milestone: First unit under construction at OPG Darlington, Canada (the first SMR build in the West); TVA Clinch River permit under NRC review; UK GDA Step 2 done.

companies.name: Rolls-Royce SMR
companies.tech: Pressurized water SMR
companies.milestone: Selected in the UK's Great British Nuclear SMR competition (2025) and chosen for three units at Ringhals, Sweden; CEZ involved for Czech deployment.

companies.name: X-energy
companies.tech: High-temperature gas-cooled pebble-bed reactor, TRISO fuel
companies.milestone: Construction permit for Dow's Long Mott site (Seadrift, Texas) under NRC review; Amazon partnership.

companies.name: Kairos Power
companies.tech: Fluoride salt-cooled high-temperature reactor, TRISO fuel
companies.milestone: Hermes test reactor under construction in Oak Ridge, Tennessee; Hermes 2 groundbreaking Apr 2026; Google power agreement.

companies.name: NuScale Power
companies.tech: Integral pressurized water SMR
companies.milestone: Only SMR design with NRC approval for its uprated 77 MWe module; Doicești project in Romania.

companies.name: Holtec
companies.tech: Pressurized water SMR
companies.milestone: Planning first units at the Palisades site, Michigan; also pursuing UK deployment.

companies.name: Westinghouse
companies.tech: PWR SMR derived from AP1000; heat-pipe microreactor (eVinci)
companies.milestone: AP300 in pre-licensing; eVinci planned for testing at Idaho National Laboratory.

companies.name: Oklo
companies.tech: Sodium-cooled fast microreactor
companies.milestone: Groves isotope test reactor reached criticality on 5 Aug 2026, the first under the DOE pilot program on private land.

companies.name: Aalo Atomics
companies.tech: Sodium-cooled microreactor
companies.milestone: Zero-power criticality of a full-scale Aalo-X at INL on 4 Jul 2026.

companies.name: Antares Nuclear
companies.tech: Microreactor
companies.milestone: Mark-0 was the first reactor in the DOE pilot program to reach criticality (4 Jun 2026, INL).

companies.name: Valar Atomics
companies.tech: Small high-temperature reactor
companies.milestone: Ward 250 reached criticality on 18 Jun 2026 at the Utah San Rafael Energy Lab.

companies.name: Deployable Energy
companies.tech: Microreactor
companies.milestone: Unity completed a criticality demonstration at INL on 30 Jun 2026.

companies.name: Radiant
companies.tech: Helium-cooled, TRISO-fuelled portable microreactor
companies.milestone: Planned for testing at INL's DOME microreactor test bed.

companies.name: NANO Nuclear Energy
companies.tech: High-temperature gas-cooled microreactor
companies.milestone: First unit planned at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

companies.name: Natura Resources
companies.tech: Liquid-fuel molten salt research reactor
companies.milestone: NRC construction permit (2024) for a research MSR at Abilene Christian University, Texas.

companies.name: Last Energy
companies.tech: Modular pressurized water microreactor
companies.milestone: Pilot in Texas; targeting industrial and data-center customers in the US and Europe.

companies.name: Deep Fission
companies.tech: PWR placed in a ~1.6 km deep borehole, using rock and water column for containment
companies.milestone: Participant in the DOE Reactor Pilot Program.

companies.name: Terrestrial Energy
companies.tech: Integral molten salt reactor
companies.milestone: Completed Canadian vendor design review phases; targeting industrial heat and power.

companies.name: Moltex
companies.tech: Stable salt reactor burning recycled spent fuel
companies.milestone: Developing a waste-recycling fuel process at Point Lepreau, New Brunswick.

companies.name: newcleo
companies.tech: Lead-cooled fast reactor running on MOX fuel
companies.milestone: Planning MOX fuel production in France and a first reactor around 2030s; Italian and French projects.

companies.name: Blykalla
companies.tech: Lead-cooled small fast reactor
companies.milestone: Developing a demonstrator in Sweden.

companies.name: Steady Energy
companies.tech: Low-pressure, low-temperature reactor for district heating
companies.milestone: Pilot plant in Helsinki region; heat supply agreements with Finnish utilities.

companies.name: Thorizon
companies.tech: Thorium molten salt reactor with replaceable cartridges
companies.milestone: Engaging French and Dutch regulators toward a first plant.

companies.name: Copenhagen Atomics
companies.tech: Thorium molten salt reactor, mass-produced container units
companies.milestone: Planned first criticality experiment at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Switzerland.

companies.name: Transmutex
companies.tech: Accelerator-driven subcritical thorium system aimed at burning long-lived waste
companies.milestone: Geneva-based; builds on accelerator-driven-system research.

companies.name: Jimmy Energy
companies.tech: Small high-temperature gas reactor for industrial heat
companies.milestone: Pursuing a first installation at an industrial site in France.

companies.name: CNNC
companies.tech: Integral pressurized water SMR
companies.milestone: World's first onshore commercial SMR, at Changjiang, Hainan; nearing operation.

companies.name: Rosatom
companies.tech: Lead-cooled fast reactor with on-site fuel cycle
companies.milestone: Under construction at Seversk as part of a closed fuel-cycle demonstration.

companies.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
companies.tech: Compact tokamak with high-temperature superconducting magnets
companies.milestone: SPARC demonstration tokamak being built in Massachusetts; ARC power plant planned in Virginia.

companies.name: Helion Energy
companies.tech: Pulsed field-reversed configuration, direct electricity recovery
companies.milestone: Building the Orion plant in Washington state to supply Microsoft.

companies.name: TAE Technologies
companies.tech: Beam-driven field-reversed configuration aiming for hydrogen-boron fuel
companies.milestone: Operating experimental devices in California.

companies.name: Tokamak Energy
companies.tech: Spherical tokamak with HTS magnets
companies.milestone: Also commercializes HTS magnet technology.

companies.name: Proxima Fusion
companies.tech: Quasi-isodynamic stellarator with HTS magnets
companies.milestone: Spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics; demo stellarator planned.

companies.name: Type One Energy
companies.tech: Stellarator
companies.milestone: Working with TVA at the Bull Run site, Tennessee.

companies.name: General Fusion
companies.tech: Magnetized target fusion with liquid-metal compression
companies.milestone: LM26 demonstration machine in Richmond, British Columbia.

companies.name: Marvel Fusion
companies.tech: Short-pulse laser inertial fusion with nanostructured targets
companies.milestone: Building a laser research facility with Colorado State University.
